CommunityApplications.Profile:
Community-maintained Unraid applications by MrPatates.
- **Endfield-Check-in** (Docker): automatically claims the SKPORT daily check-in rewards of Arknights: Endfield, with a web UI. Source and support: https://github.com/MrPatates/endfield-checkin - **THERMALRIGHT DIGITAL** (plugin): drives the USB display of Thermalright Peerless Assassin 140 Digital coolers with host CPU metrics and RGB effects. Source and support: https://github.com/MrPatates/thermalright-digital-unraid
Each application is open source and has its own GitHub repository with documentation and an issue tracker; please report problems there. This repository only publishes their Community Applications templates.
